messages:
rory: opened a small PR to add a canonical parsing example for function/tool outputs (create_reminder). Adds a JSON-schema, a short parsing-fallback paragraph, and examples in Go + TS. PR: <https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2080|github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/2080>

maya: skimmed the diff. big +1 for the explicit schema. nit: the example uses `when` as an integer unix timestamp — can we force RFC3339 string instead? avoids timezone confusion. also prefer explicit enum for `priority` instead of freeform string.

sam: yep i can swap the schema. i'll add a Go snippet showing a typed struct and a tiny TS example with `as const` enum. for Go sketch: ```go
type Reminder struct {
  Title string `json:\"title\"`
  When  string `json:\"when\"` // RFC3339
  Priority string `json:\"priority\"`
}
// call: client.CallTool(ctx, "create_reminder", CallOptions{ Schema: CreateReminderSchema })
```

jordan: CI flagged two issues: fenced code blocks in examples/funcs/create_reminder.md are missing language tags, and there's a stray trailing comma in the inline JSON example. i'll push a cleanup commit. :mag:

alice: ops ask: add a one-liner to the runbook about how to disable strict schema enforcement during incidents (flag: `schema_enforcement=false` in runtime config) and how to pin traffic to model v2.1 while we triage. keep it very visible.

rory: added the runbook note and a rollback snippet in the PR description per alice. also switched `when` -> string RFC3339 and changed `priority` to `enum: [\"low\",\"medium\",\"high\"]`. pushed new branch `rory/reminder-schema-rfc`.

sam: pushed Go + TS snippets. TS example: `const createReminderSchema = { type: 'object', properties: { title: {type:'string'}, when: {type:'string', format:'date-time'}, priority: {type:'string', enum:['low','medium','high']} }, required: ['title','when'] } as const; await client.callTool('create_reminder', { schema: createReminderSchema });`

maya: can we add one sentence about runtime fallback ordering in the parsing section? suggestion: "Runtime parsing order: validate against schema -> attempt light coercions (e.g., parse RFC3339 date strings, cast numeric strings to integers) -> return structured error if still invalid."
jordan: i reworded that sentence to be explicit about date parsing: "We attempt ISO8601/RFC3339 parsing of date strings before failing; numeric coercions may be attempted for integer fields. If strict mode is enabled, coercions are not applied." pushed grammar and code-fence fixes to `rory/reminder-schema-rfc`.

docbot: link-checker: 1 broken link discovered (docs/events/old-events.md) referenced in the examples. suggested fix applied in `link-sweep-2026` branch. @rory please cherry-pick if you want the doc link fixed in this PR.

rory: cherry-picked link-sweep commit into the branch. thanks docbot. ready for a final review — tests included: docs/tests/validate_fenced_blocks.py extracts fenced JSON and runs them through the schema validator.

jordan: ran the tests locally, all good. CI green on 4601234779. i'm going to merge after a final look from maya.

maya: LGTM. merging and will announce in #docs-updates. thanks all :tada: 

docbot: ci-bot: all checks passed on 4601234779 — merged and deployed to staging.
